name: Leonard Shryock
office: City of Norwalk, Member of the City Council

items.text: Leonard Shryock has worked as an educator in the Norwalk-La Mirada school district and previously served on the Norwalk City Council as vice mayor. He also served on the Norwalk-La Mirada school board.

sentences.text: Leonard Shryock has worked as an educator in the Norwalk-La Mirada school district and previously served on the Norwalk City Council as vice mayor.
He also served on the Norwalk-La Mirada school board.

items.text: His campaign says he wants to focus on public safety, accountability for tax dollars, city services, and communication. In 2018, he was the only council member to vote against a solid waste contract with Athens Services. He said a competing bid from CR&R would have lower rates for residents and businesses. In 2016, he opposed filling a vacant council seat by appointment, voting instead to hold a special election so that the appointee would not start with incumbent status.
